title: 第1021章 恶魔尽退第1020章 魔尊臣服
lines: “幽冥敕令，血脉为引，魂火为契，万世臣服！”
林烬双手结出一个玄奥无比、仿佛沟通九幽本源法则的印记，
指尖流淌出三道细微却蕴含至高意志的赤金色血线——
那是蕴含九狱炎骨本源的精血！
血线精准地没入三团本命之火的核心！
仿佛烙铁印入灵魂深处！
三位魔尊同时发出凄厉至极的惨嚎，庞大的魔躯剧烈抽搐！
本命之火剧烈跳动，其上瞬间烙印下了九道细密的、闪烁着赤金神芒的骨纹锁链！
一股无法抗拒、深入灵魂、连接着林烬血脉的绝对契约就此形成！
从此以后，它们的生死存亡，皆在林烬一念之间！
剧烈的痛苦过后，三位魔尊反而感到一种诡异的轻松——
那源于血脉的绝对压制感，因这契约的建立，
似乎变得“温和”了一些，不再那么充满毁灭性，
而是转化为一种明确的、必须服从的规则。
它们看向林烬的眼神，彻底变成了最虔诚、最卑微的奴仆。
“滚回幽冥！约束尔等部属！若有半分差池，尔等便先行湮灭！”
林烬冷冷命令道，声音带着不容置疑的威严，
同时也悄然开始疯狂汲取幽冥神域中残存的能量，恢复那几乎枯竭的灵力。
“是！是！谨遵主宰法旨！”
三位魔尊如蒙大赦，再不敢有丝毫迟疑。
骨狱魔尊发出震天咆哮，幽影魔尊尖啸着传达意志，
噬魂魔尊的灵魂波动覆盖整个战场。
那些残余的、早已被林烬神威吓破胆的恶魔大军，
如同退潮般疯狂地朝着那巨大的空间裂缝涌去，
争先恐后地逃离这片让它们恐惧的天地。
林烬负手而立，目光平静地注视着如黑色潮水般退却的恶魔大军。
他表面威严如渊如狱，内心却在飞速盘算着恢复的进度。
“必须撑到它们全部离开…必须让遗落之城的人看到绝对的掌控…
不能露出一丝破绽…”
每一次呼吸，都疯狂地压榨着幽冥神域最后的力量。
终于，最后一只恶魔的身影消失在空间裂缝之中。
那巨大的裂缝，在失去了恶魔力量的支撑后，
开始缓缓蠕动、收缩，最终彻底弥合，只留下满目疮痍、魔气尚未散尽的焦土。
“主宰…吾等…在此恭候您的吩咐。”
三位魔尊收敛了所有凶戾，如同最温顺的看门犬，
低眉顺眼地侍立一旁，大气不敢出。
content_en:
"The Netherworld's edict, the blood is the guide, the soul fire is the contract, and I will surrender to you forever!"
Lin Jin's hands formed an extremely mysterious mark that seemed to communicate the original laws of Jiuyou.
Three subtle lines of red-gold blood flowed from the fingertips but contained the supreme will——
That is the essence and blood that contains the origin of the Nine Hell Flame Bones!
The blood line accurately penetrated into the core of the three groups of natal fire!
"Tsk-!"
It's like a branding iron is stamped deep into the soul!
The three Demon Lords simultaneously let out shrill howls, and their huge demonic bodies twitched violently!
The fire of life beat violently, and nine fine bone-patterned chains shining with red-gold divine light were instantly imprinted on it!
An absolute contract that is irresistible, goes deep into the soul, and connects Lin Jin's bloodline is formed!
From then on, their life and death depended on Lin Jin's thoughts!
"Ah...!"
After the intense pain, the three Demon Lords felt a strange sense of relief——
The sense of absolute oppression stemming from bloodline, due to the establishment of this contract,
It seems to have become "milder" and no longer so destructive,
Instead, it is transformed into a clear rule that must be obeyed.
When they looked at Lin Jin, they turned into the most pious and humble slaves.
"Go back to the Netherworld! Restrain your subordinates! If there is even the slightest difference, you will be annihilated first!"
Lin Jin ordered coldly, his voice carrying unquestionable majesty.
At the same time, he also quietly began to frantically absorb the remaining energy in the Netherworld God Realm to restore the almost exhausted spiritual power.
"Yes! Yes! Follow the Lord's decree!"
As if the three Demon Lords had been granted amnesty, they no longer dared to hesitate at all.
The Bone Hell Demon Lord roared loudly, and the Shadow Demon Lord screamed to convey his will.
The Soul-Eating Demon Lord's soul waves cover the entire battlefield.
Those remnants of the demonic army that have long been frightened by the forest embers god,
Like an ebbing tide, it rushes crazily towards the huge space crack,
Scrambling to escape from this world that frightens them.
Lin Jin stood with his hands behind his hands, looking calmly at the demon army retreating like a black tide.
On the outside, he was as majestic as an abyss, but inside he was rapidly calculating the progress of his recovery.
"We must hold on until they all leave... we must let the people of the Forgotten City see their absolute control...
No flaws should be exposed..."
Every breath was frantically squeezing out the last power of the Netherworld God Realm.
Finally, the figure of the last demon disappeared into the cracks in space.
That huge crack, after losing the support of the devil's power,
It began to slowly squirm and shrink, and finally healed completely, leaving only the devastated and scorched earth where the demonic energy had not yet dissipated.
"Master... we... are here to await your orders."
The three Demon Lords restrained all their ferocity, like the most docile guard dogs,
He stood aside with a low eyebrow, not daring to express his anger.
title_en: Chapter 1021 The Demons Retreat Chapter 1020 The Demon Lord Surrenders
